planets.name: TIC 88785435 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TIC 88785435 with a 10.5-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TIC 88785435 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TIC 88785435. Its orbit and size follow Vach et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
